author.name: A.R. Pyx
bio: I write historical adventure set at the edges of big changes, so far the 1890s and the 1930s, when old certainties break apart and ordinary people have to decide what they will protect, betray, or become.

I’m an archaeologist, and my fiction grows out of the same questions as the day job: where documented history ends, where imagination begins, and how each shapes the other. The research in the books is real; the trouble the characters get into is mine.

Echoes of Lost Worlds is a 1930s relic-hunting series, one relic and one year per book, on the road to war. It starts with 1934: Caught in the Crossroads. Hic Non Sunt Dracones is a standalone novella set in 1897 Brazil, in the King Solomon’s Mines tradition.
